Name: Bomb Rat
Rules Text: Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can make the following bonus action: Set Up Bomb Rat [Bonus Action]: A Giant Rat is summoned and added to the commanding player's warband. Set up the Giant Rat fighter within 3" of the fighter and choose a number between 1 and 6. This number is the fuse length. Use a dice placed next to the Giant Rat to track the fuse length. Each time that Giant Rat activates, roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the fuse length, the bomb detonates. If the roll is equal or less than the fuse length, the Giant Rat is activated as normal and the fuse length is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1). When the bomb detonates, the blast template is centred on the Giant Rat. Each other fighter in the template is hit with the following attack (Rend -2, Damage d3), then the Giant Rat is taken down (it does not count towards flee tests). If the Giant Rat is taken down and the bomb has not yet detonated, roll a dice as above to see if it detonates or not.
